about.introduction: I’m Vyshnav, a Computer Science Engineering student interested in what makes useful software work.
paragraphs: At Srinivas University, I’m studying the foundations of computer science while building full-stack applications and exploring applied AI. I enjoy turning a practical problem into a working system, from its database to the interface people use.
Freelance work, internships, and academic projects have given me a place to put that learning into practice. I’m looking for software engineering opportunities where I can keep building and learning.

projects.title: Travox Travel Hub
projects.description: A travel planning platform that connects custom itineraries, road-distance quotations, and lead management in one workflow.
projects.problem: Planning a custom tour involves several handoffs. Destinations, road distances, vehicle choices, and pricing all have to agree before a travel operator can send a quote.
projects.solution: I built a trip builder and an administrative workspace that use the same trip details, from a traveller’s first route selection to the operator’s WhatsApp quotation.

implementation.title: Configure
implementation.body: A multi-step builder captures the itinerary and vehicle. Nominatim finds the places selected by the traveller.

implementation.title: Calculate
implementation.body: OSRM computes road distances. The rental logic applies the selected vehicle’s pricing tiers to the route.

implementation.title: Follow up
implementation.body: Prisma connects the Next.js application to MongoDB. The CRM brings leads, quote sharing, and margin tracking into the operator’s workspace.

features: CMS for packages, pricing, and reviews

projects.title: AI-Powered Government Hospital Queue & Resource Management System
projects.description: A Django application connecting four hospital roles through assisted triage, queue routing, and bed availability.
projects.problem: Patients, clinicians, nurses, and administrators need different views of the same hospital workflow. Queue decisions depend on triage information and the resources available.
projects.solution: During my AI & ML internship, I built role-based dashboards that connect patient intake with predictive models, queue management, and resource tracking.

implementation.title: Intake
implementation.body: A patient-facing module brings together symptom input, chatbot support, and telehealth functionality.

implementation.title: Assess
implementation.body: Predictive health models and assisted triage support the clinical workflow in the doctor dashboard.

implementation.title: Coordinate
implementation.body: Nursing and administrative modules connect queues, bed tracking, and resource allocation through a Django application backed by SQLite.

features: Patient, doctor, nurse, and administrator modules
Smart queue routing and bed tracking

projects.title: AI-Personalised Learning Management System
projects.description: An academic mini project that uses learning activity and course progress to recommend what a learner could study next.
projects.problem: A fixed course list offers little guidance about what to study next. Learners need a path that takes their activity and progress into account.
projects.solution: I connected authentication and course management with ML-based progress tracking to generate recommendations from learner behaviour.

implementation.title: Identify
implementation.body: Authentication associates course activity with an individual learner.

implementation.title: Track
implementation.body: Course management and progress tracking record how the learner moves through the material.

implementation.title: Recommend
implementation.body: The recommendation workflow uses learning behaviour to suggest relevant content.
